name: Virtual Field Trip (VFT) module for Colonization and Succession in Mangrove Swamps
product_description: A researcher-developed interactive multimedia biology-learning programme that uses text, graphics, video, audio, photographs, communication features, and links to teach Form Four students about mangrove colonization, succession, and plant adaptations.

why: This is a module-specific design rationale combining established theories for Form Four Biology students, not a distinct general learning theory.

The intervention's recorded-performance review and checklist-based self-assessment are a direct instance of Video-Based Reflection, while the role-play and recording are supporting activities rather than a distinct general element.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns video feedback generally and does not establish that learners reviewed and interpreted their own recorded performance.
